findings.explanation: No purchase order document exists for this transaction at all - PO-1005 is referenced by both the invoice and the receipt but was never provided, so its issuance and terms cannot be verified.
REC-1005 is dated 2026-07-18, three days before the invoice it references (INV-1005, dated 2026-07-21), an out-of-sequence receipt date not explained by any available document.
